name: qa-game
description: Game testing for Unity, Unreal and Godot: engine test frameworks, frame-time and memory profiling, gameplay record and replay, and multiplayer coverage. Includes the six-category game-test taxonomy and a platform certification overview (Sony TRC, Nintendo Lotcheck, Xbox Requirements, Steam Direct). An authoring agent (game-test-scenario-author) detects the engine, scaffolds the test tree, and writes one scenario per spec.
